# A #N inside a Markdown link opens the tickets view, which then loads every ticket chunk

## Context

Found in team:engine release testing of the Portal (`apps/portal`), 2026-10-20, in headless Chrome against the dev server on `origin/dev` 4844087a77. In `learn/blog/the-organism-already-existed.md`, the link `[… Discussion #14422](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/14422)` renders as two links. The second, `#14422`, opens `#/news/tickets/14422`. That view then fetched 47 ticket chunks one after another in 25 s and showed nothing; it was still fetching when the run stopped. A known ticket such as `#10074` takes 3 requests. Reproduced 2/2.

## The Problem

Two defects meet on one click:

1. The ticket autolink rewrites ids inside links that already exist. It counts 18 such links in 5 files, 16 of which point at PRs or Discussions, so the rewritten link opens the wrong view.
2. An id the tickets index lacks makes the view walk every chunk folder. There are about 1,061, which is roughly nine minutes at the rate observed. The same happens for any unknown id typed into the URL.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/component/Markdown.mjs`: `regexTicketId = /(^|[\s(])#(\d+)\b/g` is replaced in the raw Markdown before it renders (step 3 of the content pass). Fenced and inline code are protected first, but existing links are not, so `[PR #14458](url)` becomes `[PR <a href="…/14458">#14458</a>](url)`.
- `apps/portal/view/news/tickets/MainContainerController.mjs#ensureRecordLoaded`: when the id map names a chunk, one targeted load happens. When it doesn't, the method falls back to `for (…folders) await tree.onFolderItemClick(folder)` across every unloaded folder.
- Design authority: `ensureRecordLoaded`'s own comment says the build-emitted id map "names the chunk folder containing the item, so one targeted load replaces the sequential scan". An id absent from a loaded id map is therefore not a ticket. The sequential scan remains only for a missing map.

## The Fix

- `Markdown.mjs`: protect Markdown links (`[text](url)`) the way inline code is protected before the ticket replacement, so an id inside a link's text or URL stays as written.
- `ensureRecordLoaded`: when the id map loaded and has no entry for the id, return `null` without scanning. Keep the sequential scan only for when the map is unavailable.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 (unit): Markdown with `[PR #14458](https://example.com/14458)` renders exactly one anchor, and its href is the original URL. A bare `#14458` in prose still becomes a ticket link.
- [ ] AC-2 (unit): `ensureRecordLoaded` for an id absent from a loaded id map loads no folder and returns `null`. An id present in the map still loads its one chunk.
- [ ] AC-3: on the Portal, clicking a `#N` link that points at a PR or Discussion opens that URL, and `#/news/tickets/<unknown id>` settles to the view's empty state without fetching chunks.

## Out of Scope

- Making the tickets view say "not found" in words. The empty state is enough for this ticket.
- The blog's relative links, filed separately.
